contract: Hoang Yen Beauty & Spa static Czech landing page. Primary user job: understand the salon's services and prices, then reserve or call. Primary action: Rezervovat termín. Hierarchy: premium hero, gift-voucher campaign, introduction, services, detailed treatments and prices, gallery, contact. The limited-time procedure offer appears only in the entry popup to avoid duplicate page content. Visual direction: refined European spa editorial using the real salon identity: dimensional brass gold sampled from the storefront lettering, mocha and espresso from the facade, and warm cream-caramel from the campaign artwork. Metallic gold is reserved for brand and action emphasis; readable dark gold is used for small text. Sharp intentional crops and motion at Animate UI's 'more' level remain, while respecting prefers-reduced-motion. The navigation, reservation actions, pricing tabs, mobile menu, promotion popup and gallery lightbox must remain keyboard accessible. No horizontal overflow or clipped primary content is allowed at 390x844, 768x1024 or 1440x900.

accessibility.evidence: Chrome Lighthouse navigation audits previously scored Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100 and Agentic Browsing 100 on both desktop and mobile. The new promotion popup was inspected in the browser accessibility tree as a named modal dialog; focus enters on its close button, Tab is contained, Escape closes it, background scrolling is restored, and reduced-motion removes its transition. Existing keyboard behavior for the mobile menu, pricing tabs and gallery remains in place.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and visually reviewed exact 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x900 captures with the redesigned entry promotion open. Desktop uses a balanced poster-and-offer split layout; tablet and mobile collapse to a compact vertical card. The poster crop, offer grid, CTA, phone link and close control fit without horizontal clipping, including the shorter 375x667 viewport.

loading.reason: The page is a static brochure with no internal asynchronous data view or submit flow that exposes a loading state; image loading reserves dimensions to prevent layout shift.

empty.reason: All service, pricing, promotion, gallery and contact content is authored statically; there is no user-dependent collection that can be empty.

error.reason: There is no internal request or form transaction to render an application error state; reservation and phone actions hand off to external/native destinations.

partial.reason: The static page has no incremental or partially returned dataset; each authored section is available with the document.

success.evidence: The document, stylesheet, script, premium hero and service imagery loaded successfully from the local server; navigation, pricing tabs, mobile menu, gallery lightbox, reservation links and contact calls remained operational during browser QA.

permission.reason: The website does not request account, camera, location, notification or other runtime permissions.

renderedEvidence.observation: Exact mobile viewport: the cropped campaign art, two-column discount grid, CTA and phone link all fit in one compact vertical card; the close control remains touch-friendly and no horizontal overflow is present.
Exact tablet viewport: the promotion uses the full split composition with a readable campaign crop, structured offer summary and visible close control.
Exact desktop viewport: the premium split campaign card remains fully above the fold; poster and offer content have balanced visual weight against the warm blurred backdrop.
